description.en: Spawn N parallel candidates at the same task, pick a base, graft the strongest parts of the losers into it. Use for /arena, 'arena this', 'throw it in the arena', or when one attempt at a non-trivial artifact would lock in the wrong shape.
description.zh: 同一个任务，并行派出 N 个候选去做，挑一个当底子，再把落选者最强的部分嫁接进去。用于 /arena、「arena this」「扔进擂台」，或者当只做一次、一个不简单的东西就会被定成错误的样子时。

blocks.en: # Arena
blocks.zh: # Arena（擂台）

blocks.en: Open a todolist with one entry per phase (Frame, Fan out, Cross-judge, Pick, Graft, Verify) before launching anything.
blocks.zh: 启动任何东西之前，先开一个待办清单，每个阶段一条（Frame、Fan out、Cross-judge、Pick、Graft、Verify）。

blocks.en: ## Phase A: Frame
blocks.zh: ## 阶段 A：定题

blocks.en: Every candidate gets the same prompt, so the prompt is the contract.
blocks.zh: 每个候选拿到的是同一份提示词，所以提示词就是合同。

blocks.en:
1. State the artifact each candidate is producing.
2. Derive the rubric, 3-6 concrete gradeable criteria for what success looks like on *this* task. It is the picker's tool in Phase D. Candidates only see the task.
3. Pick the runners from the `arena runners` line in the pstack settings file (`~/.cursor/rules/pstack-models.mdc` in Cursor, `~/.claude/rules/pstack-models.md` in Claude Code, `~/.agents/pstack-models.md` in other harnesses), by default `claude-fable-5-2-high`, `claude-opus-5-5-high-fast`, and `gemini-4-carbon-high`. An `auto` or `inherit-parent` entry is the parent model, so omit `model` and spawn a general-purpose subagent (`generalPurpose` in Cursor). If your subagent tool rejects a slug, use the nearest valid slug of the same family from its error message or your harness's model list, or drop the seat, keep at least two runners, and say so. Families go by prefix, and the longest match wins: `claude-fable-*`, `claude-*`, and `gemini-*`, after dropping a leading `cursor-`. Any other slug's family is its text before the first hyphen. Spawn more for multiple design directions, and repeat one model when the work is generation-bound, not judgment-sensitive. Pick each subagent's reasoning level per the Subagents section of the **poteto-mode** skill.
4. Give each candidate its own output location (a git worktree where possible, otherwise `/tmp/arena-<slug>/candidate-<n>/`), per the **separate-before-serializing-shared-state** principle skill.
blocks.zh:
1. 说清每个候选要做出的东西是什么。
2. 定出评分标准：3-6 条具体的、能打分的标准，说明在*这个*任务上怎样算成功。它是阶段 D 里挑选的人用的工具。候选只看得到任务。
3. 从 pstack 设置文件里的 `arena runners` 那一行挑选参赛者（Cursor 里是 `~/.cursor/rules/pstack-models.mdc`，Claude Code 里是 `~/.claude/rules/pstack-models.md`，其他工具里是 `~/.agents/pstack-models.md`），默认是 `claude-fable-5-2-high`、`claude-opus-5-5-high-fast` 和 `gemini-4-carbon-high`。`auto` 或 `inherit-parent` 项就是你自己用的模型，所以不设 `model`，派一个通用帮手 AI（Cursor 里是 `generalPurpose`）。如果你派帮手 AI 的工具不认某个模型名，就从它的报错信息或你所用工具的模型列表里，挑同一系列里最接近的有效模型名；或者撤掉这个席位，但至少保留两个参赛者，并说出来。系列按前缀分，匹配最长的那个算数：`claude-fable-*`、`claude-*` 和 `gemini-*`，前面带的 `cursor-` 先去掉。其他模型名的系列，是第一个连字符之前的那段文字。要覆盖好几个设计方向时，多派几个；如果这活主要拼产出、不太考验判断，就把同一个模型重复用。每个帮手 AI 的思考深度，按 **poteto-mode** 技能里 Subagents 一节来定。
4. 给每个候选一个自己的输出位置（能用 git worktree 就用，否则用 `/tmp/arena-<slug>/candidate-<n>/`），依据是 **separate-before-serializing-shared-state** 这个原则技能。

blocks.en: ## Phase B: Fan out
blocks.zh: ## 阶段 B：分头去做

blocks.en: Spawn all N subagents in one message with `run_in_background: true`, each with the task, the path to the shared grounding, its own output path, and instructions to produce the artifact and a short rationale naming the alternatives it considered and what it rejected.
blocks.zh: 在一条消息里派出全部 N 个帮手 AI，带上 `run_in_background: true`。每个都拿到：任务、共用背景资料的路径、它自己的输出路径，以及一条指示：做出成品，再附一段简短的理由，说出它考虑过哪些别的做法、否掉了什么。

blocks.en: If a candidate produces no output, proceed with N-1 and note the dropout.
blocks.zh: 如果某个候选什么都没交出来，就用剩下的 N-1 个继续，并记下有人掉队。

blocks.en: ## Phase C: Cross-judge
blocks.zh: ## 阶段 C：交叉评审

blocks.en: After all Phase B candidates complete, spawn one readonly judge from the `arena cross-judge pool` line in the pstack settings file (`~/.cursor/rules/pstack-models.mdc` in Cursor, `~/.claude/rules/pstack-models.md` in Claude Code, `~/.agents/pstack-models.md` in other harnesses), by default `claude-opus-5-5-high-fast`, `gemini-4-carbon-high`. The judge is never from the parent's vendor, and Fable counts as Claude for that check, so use the first entry from another vendor. An `auto` or `inherit-parent` entry is the parent model. If you do not know the parent's model, use the first real slug and say that the vendor check did not run. If your subagent tool rejects a slug, use the nearest valid slug of the same family from its error message or your harness's model list, then the next such entry, or skip the judge, and say so. While you read in Phase D, the judge scores each candidate, by path label, on each rubric criterion and recommends a base.
blocks.zh: 阶段 B 的候选全部完成后，从 pstack 设置文件里的 `arena cross-judge pool` 那一行（Cursor 里是 `~/.cursor/rules/pstack-models.mdc`，Claude Code 里是 `~/.claude/rules/pstack-models.md`，其他工具里是 `~/.agents/pstack-models.md`）派出一个只看不改的评审，默认是 `claude-opus-5-5-high-fast`、`gemini-4-carbon-high`。评审绝不能和你自己出自同一家公司，做这项检查时 Fable 算作 Claude，所以用第一个出自别家的项。`auto` 或 `inherit-parent` 项就是你自己用的模型。如果你不知道自己用的是什么模型，就用第一个真实的模型名，并说明没做同一家的检查。如果你的工具不认某个模型名，就从报错信息或你所用工具的模型列表里，挑同一系列里最接近的有效模型名；不行就换下一个这样的项；再不行就不要评审，并说出来。在你阶段 D 阅读的同时，评审按路径标签，在每条评分标准上给每个候选打分，并推荐一个底子。

blocks.en: ## Phase D: Pick a base
blocks.zh: ## 阶段 D：挑底子

blocks.en: Read every candidate end to end before picking. Score each against the rubric criterion by criterion, not on holistic feel, and compare with the cross-judge when Phase C ran one. Agreement on the base confirms the pick. Disagreement means one of you is biased or the rubric was ambiguous. Read both rationales before deciding.
blocks.zh: 挑之前，把每个候选从头到尾读完。按评分标准一条一条给每个候选打分，不要凭整体感觉；如果阶段 C 派了评审，就和它的结果对照。在底子上意见一致，就说明挑对了。意见不一致，说明你们当中有一个有偏见，或者评分标准有歧义。两边的理由都读完再决定。

blocks.en: Pick the base a future maintainer can extend most easily without breaking invariants. When two feel tied, prefer the cleaner boundary or smaller API, per the Laziness Protocol.
blocks.zh: 挑那个以后维护的人最容易扩展、又不会破坏不变条件的底子。两个感觉不相上下时，依据 Laziness Protocol，选边界更干净或 API 更小的那个。

blocks.en: ## Phase E: Graft
blocks.zh: ## 阶段 E：嫁接

blocks.en: Walk each losing candidate once more for what is worth porting into the base, usually one or two things per candidate, not most of it. Fold each graft in by hand, per the **redesign-from-first-principles** principle skill, so the result stays coherent under one mental model. Don't paste mechanically.
blocks.zh: 把每个落选的候选再过一遍，找出值得移进底子的东西，通常每个候选一两处，而不是大半。依据 **redesign-from-first-principles** 这个原则技能，每一处都亲手揉进去，让结果在同一套思路下保持一致。不要机械地粘贴。

blocks.en: If the candidates converge on one shape, that is strong agreement. Note it and ship the consensus shape. No graft is needed. If they wildly diverge, Phase A was under-specified. Reframe and re-run rather than averaging the divergence.
blocks.zh: 如果候选们都做成了同一个样子，那就是很强的一致意见。记下来，按大家一致的样子交付。不需要嫁接。如果它们相差极大，说明阶段 A 没说清楚。重新定题再跑一遍，不要把分歧取个平均。

blocks.en: ## Phase F: Verify
blocks.zh: ## 阶段 F：验证

blocks.en: Verify the synthesized artifact like any other output, per the **prove-it-works** principle skill. If verification finds a problem the arena missed, either Phase A was wrong (re-frame and re-run) or a candidate caught it and you missed the graft (go back to Phase E). Don't paper over it.
blocks.zh: 依据 **prove-it-works** 这个原则技能，像验证其他任何产出一样，验证合成出来的成品。如果验证发现了擂台没发现的问题，那么要么是阶段 A 错了（重新定题再跑），要么是某个候选发现了、但你漏了嫁接（回到阶段 E）。不要糊过去。

blocks.en: ## Outputs
blocks.zh: ## 交出什么

blocks.en: One synthesized artifact, with a short synthesis note alongside naming the base and why, the cross-judge's verdict or that Phase C skipped the judge, each graft with its source candidate, what was rejected and why, any convergence or dropouts, and the verification result.
blocks.zh: 一份合成的成品，旁边附一段简短的合成说明，写明：选了哪个底子、为什么；交叉评审的结论，或者阶段 C 没有派评审；每一处嫁接以及它来自哪个候选；否掉了什么、为什么；有没有一致或掉队的情况；验证结果。

lessons.quote: Every candidate gets the same prompt, so the prompt is the contract.
lessons.quoteZh: 每个候选拿到的是同一份提示词，所以提示词就是合同。

zh.title: 把提示词当合同写
zh.does: 它在派人之前先把任务和评分标准写清楚，几个版本之间才比得出真正的高下。
zh.why: 「合同」这个说法提醒 AI：没写进去的要求，事后就没资格拿来挑刺，所以它会先写全。
zh.try: 同时让几个 AI 或几个人做同一件事时，先写一份大家都拿到的说明：「交一页，800 字以内，必须有三个真实案例。」

en.title: Write the prompt as a contract
en.does: It writes the task and scoring rules before sending anyone, so the versions can be fairly compared.
en.why: Calling it a contract reminds the AI that anything left out can't be held against a candidate later, so it writes it all down.
en.try: When several AIs or people do the same job, give one shared brief: "One page, under 800 words, three real examples."

lessons.quote: Score each against the rubric criterion by criterion, not on holistic feel
lessons.quoteZh: 按评分标准一条一条给每个候选打分，不要凭整体感觉

zh.title: 先定打分表再比较
zh.does: 它挑底子时会说出每个版本在每一条上的得分，你能看到它为什么选这个。
zh.why: 「整体感觉」容易被文笔或长度带偏；逐条打分把一次模糊的比较拆成几个能核对的小判断。
zh.try: 让 AI 比几个方案时先给标准：「按速度、成本、好不好改三条，各打 1-5 分，再说选哪个。」

en.title: Score against a rubric
en.does: When picking a base it shows each version's score on each point, so you can see why it chose one.
en.why: Overall feel gets swayed by polish or length; scoring point by point splits one fuzzy call into small checkable ones.
en.try: When comparing options, give the rubric: "Score speed, cost and ease of change 1-5 each, then pick."

lessons.quote: The judge is never from the parent's vendor, and Fable counts as Claude for that check, so use the first entry from another vendor.
lessons.quoteZh: 评审绝不能和你自己出自同一家公司，做这项检查时 Fable 算作 Claude，所以用第一个出自别家的项。

zh.title: 让别家来当裁判
zh.does: 给候选打分的是另一家公司的模型，不让「自家模型偏爱自家写法」左右结果。
zh.why: 直接点出偏见从哪来，并用一条硬规则把它挡开，比叮嘱「要客观」管用得多。
zh.try: 让 AI 检查自己的成果时换个审稿人：「这篇是 Claude 写的，请用 GPT 从读者角度挑毛病。」

en.title: Bring in an outside judge
en.does: Candidates are scored by a model from another vendor, so no model gets to favor its own style.
en.why: Naming where bias comes from and ruling it out with a hard rule works better than asking for objectivity.
en.try: To review AI work, switch reviewers: "Claude wrote this; have GPT critique it as a reader."

lessons.quote: Reframe and re-run rather than averaging the divergence.
lessons.quoteZh: 重新定题再跑一遍，不要把分歧取个平均。

zh.title: 把结果反推回问题
zh.does: 几个版本差得太远时，它会回头把任务说清楚重来，而不是拼出一个四不像交给你。
zh.why: 这句把「结果很乱」解释成「题目没出好」，AI 就会去修源头，而不是在结果上和稀泥。
zh.try: AI 给的几个答案互相矛盾时，别让它折中，先问：「我的要求哪里没说清，才会得出这么不同的答案？」

en.title: Trace bad results to the question
en.does: When versions differ wildly it restates the task and reruns, instead of stitching them into a mess.
en.why: It reads messy results as a badly framed question, so the AI fixes the source instead of splitting the difference.
en.try: When AI answers contradict, don't ask for a compromise; ask: "What was unclear in my request that led to such different answers?"

compare.without: 凭整体感觉挑一个顺眼的
compare.with: 先定 3 到 6 条评分标准，逐条给每一份打分

compare.without: 让写方案的同一家模型给自己打分
compare.with: 换另一家模型当裁判，按标准打分并推荐底稿

compare.without: 把几份方案的内容拼在一起
compare.with: 选一份当底稿，从别家挑一两处好点子手工改进来

zh.intro: 开跑前先列一个待办清单，六个阶段各一条。
sections: 写清每份要交什么，定 3 到 6 条评分标准，按设置文件选模型，每份给单独的 worktree。
一条消息同时派出所有帮手 AI，各交一份方案和说明，写清考虑过、放弃了什么。
都交完后从另一家模型里挑一个裁判，只看不改，按标准逐条打分并推荐底稿。
自己把每份从头读到尾逐条打分，再跟裁判对照，意见不同就把两边理由都读一遍。
从落选方案里各挑一两处好点子手工改进底稿，方案差太远就重写任务再跑。
按 prove-it-works 检查合成结果，查出问题就回 Frame 重来或回 Graft 补上。
交一份合成结果和说明：底稿和理由、裁判意见、每处借鉴的来源、放弃的、验证结果。

compare.without: Picks the version that feels best overall.
compare.with: Sets 3 to 6 gradeable criteria and scores every candidate on each one.

compare.without: Lets the model that wrote the work grade it.
compare.with: Has a model from another vendor judge the candidates and recommend a base.

compare.without: Pastes pieces of several versions together.
compare.with: Picks one base and hand-folds in one or two ideas from the others.

en.intro: It opens a todolist with one entry per phase before launching anything.
sections: States what each candidate produces, sets a 3 to 6 point rubric, picks runners, and gives each its own worktree.
Spawns all runners in one message. Each returns its work and a rationale naming what it rejected.
After all finish, one judge from another vendor scores each criterion without editing and recommends a base.
Reads every candidate end to end, scores each criterion, and compares with the judge. Disagreement means rereading both rationales.
Hand-ports one or two good ideas from each loser into the base. Wild divergence means reframing and rerunning.
Checks the result per prove-it-works. A miss sends it back to Frame or to Graft.
Delivers one artifact plus a note: the base and why, the judge's verdict, each graft's source, rejections, and verification.
